reason: I already have a designer and a nephew who does logos, and I don't see how a WhatsApp check on M-Pesa messages is my problem as a hotel owner. Looks like a clever demo, not something I'd pay for this month.
objection: Who is actually sending me these messages, and why would I give an AI agent access to my customer chats and my business? I'd need to trust it with my data before I trusted it with my replies.
would_change_my_mind: A clear, free trial on my own WhatsApp inbox showing it drafts correct replies that save me hours each week, with the owner able to approve every message.
